claim: SWARM-COORDINATION: giving parallel Builders their peers' verified discoveries + rejected approaches (blackboard consumption) beats blind parallelism (eratchet-equivalent) at MATCHED compute, on flatline tasks
expected: blackboard-consuming arm solves >= baseline+2 on the flatline subset, OR equal solves at strictly lower total tokens (arms within +/-20% tokens) -- a real lift from coordination above raw parallel tries
falsifier: treatment within +/-1 solves of baseline AND not cheaper => reading peers' findings adds nothing blind parallelism did not => coordination is NOT the lever; swarm ships as a user feature, NOT wired into the ratchet (no retry-with-better-prompt, the scaffold death spiral)
note: prior favors null: this programme found search is not the bottleneck (write-back is).

claim: MECHANISM GUARD: any lift is mediated by agents ACTUALLY using shared information, not by seed/variance/parallelism
expected: in treatment solves, the blackboard was read and its content demonstrably shaped the solve (trajectory references a peer discovery or avoids a peer's rejected approach) in >=50% of them
falsifier: treatment beats baseline YET shared content was used in <20% of its solves => the gain is a parallelism/variance confound (eratchet already gives parallel tries) => do NOT credit the swarm; re-run with more seeds
note: the swarm-specific analog of loop-control's usage guard (the Ledger was offered but called 0 times).

claim: FLATLINE-SPECIFIC: shared information helps the no-gradient tasks (where a lone ratchet stalls) more than the gradient tasks
expected: (treatment - baseline) solve delta is larger on the flatline subset than on the gradient subset
falsifier: delta_flatline <= delta_gradient => shared information is not where the value is; coordination does not target the ratchet's actual failure mode
note: flatline = monolithic checker, total=1, no partial-credit gradient.
